name: Sticky Chicken
instructions: Cut three shallow slits in each drumstick. Combine the soy sauce, honey, olive oil, tomato paste and mustard, then coat the chicken with this mixture.
Allow 30 minutes for the short marinating option. If preparing ahead, cover and refrigerate overnight as described by the source.
Heat a conventional oven to 200°C (or a fan-forced oven to 180°C). Arrange the chicken in a shallow roasting tray.
Roast for 35 minutes, turning occasionally, until the drumsticks are thoroughly cooked and coated with the sticky glaze.
description: TheMealDB 53110; original Good Food team recipe. Original yield 4, prep 5 min and cooking 35 min verified with the linked publisher. Allow 30 min marinating. Original UK metric tablespoons are 15 ml, not Australian 20 ml; teaspoon is 5 ml. UK tomato purée is listed as tomato paste. Core chicken dish; optional serving sides are not silently added.

name: Banana and oatmeal cookies
allergens: Oats — check gluten and cross-contact labelling
instructions: Peel the bananas and mash them, leaving a little texture.
Line an oven tray with baking paper. Shape the mixture into discs approximately 8 cm across.
Bake with fan heat for about 20 minutes, until the outside is golden and slightly crisp.
Serve warm or cold. The source allows a couple of days in a sealed container.
description: Éric G.’s original public-domain recipe, yielding 3 servings (not 3 cookies). The source’s 2 bananas and 100 g oats are retained. Its explicitly optional cinnamon and honey are omitted from this base recipe; no duplicate variation is created. Oats are not classified gluten-free.
